name: torbscript
description: Syntax highlighting for TorbScript (.trb) files and ```trb code blocks in Markdown (editor and preview), plus semantic highlighting from `torb highlight`.

torbscript.executablePath.markdownDescription: Path to the `torb` executable used for semantic highlighting (`torb highlight --stdin`). Empty searches `build/release/torb[.exe]` (what `sh tools/bootstrap.sh` writes), then `bootstrap/target/release/torb[.exe]` and `bootstrap/target/debug/torb[.exe]`, under every open workspace folder, then falls back to `torb` on `PATH`.

torbscript.semanticHighlighting.enabled.description: Ask `torb highlight` to color fields, locals, parameters, cases, methods and generics precisely. When off, or when the executable cannot be found or run, only the TextMate grammar's (less precise) colors are used - never an error popup.

semanticTokenModifiers.description: A `var` binding, a `var` field, a `var` parameter, or a `var fn` - at its declaration and at every call of it. The only visual difference from a `const`/non-`var` name of the same kind (see README.md).
